messages:
erin: Heads up 3 audit entries for KMS missing after we applied infra-egress-default-deny a few mins ago. anyone watching?
pete: which policy exactly? name + namespace pls.
mina: infra/netpols/infra-egress-default-deny.yaml in infra ns, applied ~3840999900. meant to only allow logging-proxy and HSM CIDR.
erin: our audit shipper is a daemonset that sends to 10.30.5.2:443 (logging-proxy). shipper logs show TLS handshake errors and buffer full.
sec-bot: deploy-event: cert-rotation/keyroll executed at 3840999600.
pete: did we rotate internal CA last night? that would explain tls verify fails.
mina: yes, keyroll happened. I forgot to update the shipper trust bundle secret before applying netpol.
erin: local fallback? any archived blobs on nodes?
pete: check /var/log/kms-audit/archive on nodes, should have rotated tarballs. also check pod restart counts.
mina: found archives on node-03: /var/log/kms-audit/archive/2026-03-21T04-02.tar.gz. copying now.
sec-bot: incident-detected: 3840999800-3841000000 partial audit gap. severity: medium. owners: @erin @mina.
erin: mitigation: patch the shipper CA secret with new bundle and restart pods. I'll run the patch (kubectl patch secret logging-ca -n infra).
deploy-bot: applied secret patch at 3841000015, rolling restart triggered for daemonset logging-shipper.
pete: after restart, confirm shipper reconnects and flushes buffer to SIEM. also verify disk retention quota to avoid drops.
mina: post-incident actions I propose: 1) CI test for cert rotation -> shipper trust update, 2) template netpol that includes explicit allow for logging-proxy hostNetwork and podNetwork paths, 3) split RBAC so shipper cannot be impacted by controller-manager changes.
erin: agreed. I'll draft a one-page runbook and a customer-notify template if gap > 5m. currently SIEM shows ingestion resuming and rehydration in progress.
sec-bot: status-update: rehydration started at 3841000024.
erin: update: SIEM is catching up, gap reduced to ~1m. closing incident after postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:
